status: proposed construction - calculated, not built or measured

basis.L_from: L_total - leakage of the transformer pair (design_dab_transformer.json)

construction: 4 x DMEGC EE80 DMR95 stacked, 3 turns profiled litz 0.05 mm, quasi-distributed centre-leg gap (6 gaps x 1.11 mm, ferrite I-segments), outer legs ungapped, winding on a former set back 7 mm from the gapped leg, potted

electrical.L_tol: trim by gap shims so that transformer leakage + L = L_total within +/-5 % (matched set)
electrical.I_sat_basis: 1.1 x the trip fault peak (DR-03, soft turn-off path) at 100 C

core.part_number: EE80 set (DMR95) x 4 + custom gapped centre-leg segments

gap.note: fringing included (McLyman per gap); final by trim

core.asian_alternative: TDG TP4A in the same E80-class set (RFQ); powder cores rejected (core loss at 100 kHz full AC flux)

windings.name: L
windings.conductor: profiled litz 12732 x 0.05 mm, 13.7 x 3.4 mm

insulation.system: potted with the transformer pair or alone in an Al housing; winding-core basic: former wall 7 mm + 5 mm margins

levels.label: Basic DAB port 1 - PE, AC node (module, T1 core)

insulation.routine_tests: winding-core AC 2200 V rms 60 s, PD <= 10 pC at 1799 V pk

core.formula: B(t) = L*i(t)/(N*Ae); P_core = iGSE(B(t)) with the Steinmetz set

loss_grid.note: P_cu at the worst-point current shape scaled with I^2; P_core vs B_pk for a triangular flux (approximation of the DAB current shape, iGSE)

thermal.interface: Al housing or shared housing with the transformers on the cold plate, gap pad >= 3 W/mK
